description: 한국방송통신전파진흥원_라디오 채널 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국방송통신전파진흥원. 본 데이터를 통해 사용자가 주소 또는 자신의 위치 정보를 통해 해당 지역에서 청취가 가능한 라디오 채널정보(AM,FM) 정보 및 주파수 정보를 제공 받을 수 있습니다. 데이터 포멧은 XML이며 매월 제공됩니다. 입력값은 인증키, 검색구분(라디오), 경도, 위도 그리고 법정동코드 입니다. 출력값은 에로코드... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국방송통신전파진흥원. Its tags are 정보통신, 위성전파, 주파수, 방송산업, FM. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
